identity.title: Exploring Magnetic Fields in a Merging Galaxy: Comparing Polarization and Velocity Gradient in the Centaurus Galaxy

question.value: Can the Velocity Gradient Technique applied to PHANGS-ALMA CO emission trace the magnetic field of the merging Centaurus galaxy, as tested against HAWC+ dust polarization?

evidence.quote: In this study, we apply the Velocity Gradient Technique (VGT) to the merging Centaurus galaxy.
We compare gradient maps derived from the PHANGS-ALMA survey using CO emission lines with magnetic field tracings from dust polarization data obtained via the HAWC+ instrument.

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: 12CO (J = 2–1) per Introduction and Sec. 2.1 first sentence; Sec. 2.1 second sentence says J = 1 - 0 (inconsistent in the paper); velocity resolution 2.5 km/s

evidence.quote: In this study, we utilized the $\rm ^{12}CO$ (J = 2–1) emission lines provided by the Physics at High Angular Resolution in Nearby Galaxies (PHANGS)–ALMA survey
The PHANGS-ALMA survey offers $\rm ^{12}CO$ (J = 1 - 0) emission line data at a spatial resolution of approximately $8.13''$ (about 145.5 pc)
and $\rm ^{12}CO$ (J = 2–1) emission lines from the PHANGS-ALMA survey (cite: 2021ApJS..257...43L).

at a spatial resolution of approximately $8.13''$ (about 145.5 pc) and a velocity resolution of 2.5 km s$^{-1}$ for the nearby galaxy Centaurus.

method.value: Convert HAWC+ 89 micron polarization angles to B-field orientation, keep p/sigma_p > 1 pixels, smooth to FWHM ~40''

evidence.quote: Magnetic field orientations were determined using the relation $\phi_B=\phi+\pi/2$, where $\phi$ represents the polarization angle.
We limited our analysis to pixels where the polarization fraction ($p$) divided by its uncertainty ($\sigma_p$) exceeds 1 ($p/\sigma_p > 1$).
To compare with the magnetic field measured with VGT, we smooth the polarization data to FWHM $\approx40''$ matching the spatial resolution of VGT.

method.value: Convolve each thin CO channel map with 3x3 Sobel kernels to get gradients and pixel gradient angle psi_g; keep pixels by a 3 x RMS brightness threshold

evidence.quote: Each thin channel map, $p(x, y, v_{\rm los})$, undergoes convolution with 3$\times$3 Sobel kernels $G_x$ and $G_y$ to compute the gradients:
Only pixels with a brightness temperature less than three times the RMS noise are retained for subsequent analysis.
undergoes convolution with 3$\times$3 Sobel kernels $G_x$ and $G_y$

assumptions.value: Velocity caustics dominate the intensity fluctuations in the 2.5 km/s channels

evidence.quote: Given that the PHANGS-ALMA survey offers a velocity resolution of 2.5 km/s, this ensures that the velocity caustics dominate the observed intensity in the spectroscopic velocity channels.

assumptions.value: Turbulence injection scale in Centaurus may exceed the ~100 pc used for quiescent galaxies; 145.5 pc resolution assumed adequate for this pilot study

evidence.quote: it is reasonable to hypothesize that the injection scale $L_{\rm inj}$ in the Centaurus galaxy, which has experienced dynamic merger events, could be larger than 100 pc

method.value: Split each psi_g map into 20x20 pixel sub-blocks; histogram the orientations in each block, fit a Gaussian, take its peak as the block orientation

evidence.quote: The pixelized map $\psi_g(x, y, v_{\rm los})$ is segmented into 20$\times$20 pixel sub-blocks
A histogram of gradient orientations within each sub-block is produced and fitted with a Gaussian distribution.
The peak of this Gaussian distribution is taken as the dominant gradient orientation for that sub-block.
is segmented into 20$\times$20 pixel sub-blocks

fitting.value: Gaussian fit to the gradient-orientation histogram in each sub-block (priors and likelihood not stated)

evidence.quote: A histogram of gradient orientations within each sub-block is produced and fitted with a Gaussian distribution.

analysis_steps.goal: Build pseudo-Stokes maps and VGT B-field orientation

method.value: Integrate intensity-weighted cos(2 psi_gs) and sin(2 psi_gs) over the velocity range to get Q_g and U_g; B-field orientation psi_B = 0.5 arctan(U_g/Q_g) + pi/2

evidence.quote: Repeating the Steps 1 and 2 for every channel within the velocity range of interest, we can then construct the pseudo-Stokes parameters $Q_g(x,y)$ and $U_g(x,y)$:
The POS magnetic field orientation is inferred from:

assumptions.value: Turbulent eddies elongate along the magnetic field, so velocity gradients are perpendicular to the local field

evidence.quote: This anisotropy suggests that turbulent eddies elongate along magnetic field lines, manifesting notably in local reference frames.

analysis_steps.goal: Compare VGT and polarization fields with the Alignment Measure

method.value: Compute AM = 2(cos^2 theta_r - 1/2) with theta_r = |phi_B - psi_B| per pixel; map it and examine it against signal-to-noise ratio

evidence.quote: To quantify the agreement between VGT and the magnetic field inferred from polarization, we utilize the Alignment Measure (AM; (cite: GL17)), expressed as:
An AM value of 1 implies parallel alignment of $\phi_{\rm B}$ and $\psi_{\rm B}$, while -1 indicates perpendicularity.
we observe that we do not observe a negative AM at the high signal-to-noise ratio regions.

validation.value: VGT-CO compared against HAWC+ dust polarization as an independent tracer

evidence.quote: Specifically, we measure velocity gradients in the Centaurus galaxy and evaluate their effectiveness in tracing magnetic fields, using dust polarization as a comparative measure.

results_numeric.quantity: Radius of central region where VGT-CO magnetic field shows a twist

evidence.quote: it exhibits a twist across the central region of approximately 500 pc radius around the nucleus.

results_numeric.quantity: AM in the northwest of the central disk

evidence.quote: The anti-alignment, indicated by negative AM values, is observed in the two tails, while a misalignment with AM $\approx 0$ is noted in the northwest of the central disk.

findings_qualitative.value: Anti-alignment between VGT-CO and polarization-inferred fields is seen in the two tails and in the radio jet regions

evidence.quote: Specifically, we identify jet regions as areas of anti-alignment, consistent with previous reports that gradients tend to rotate 90 degrees in outflow regions.
The anti-alignment, indicated by negative AM values, is observed in the two tails

findings_qualitative.value: Alignment is best at the highest signal-to-noise ratios; no negative AM at high SNR

evidence.quote: Statistically, we find that the alignment of magnetic fields, as revealed by polarization, is most accurate in regions with the highest signal-to-noise ratios.

findings_qualitative.value: VGT-CO and HAWC+ fields agree over most of the galaxy, especially the central disk

evidence.quote: Our analysis reveals a strong correspondence between the directions indicated by these two tracers across most of the galactic image.

claims.hypothesis: VGT based on CO channel gradients can trace the magnetic field in a merging galaxy
claims.experiment: Applied VChG to the PHANGS-ALMA CO cube of Centaurus and compared the inferred field with HAWC+ 89 micron polarization using AM
claims.result: Strong correspondence between the two tracers across most of the image
claims.finding: VGT results generally agree with dust polarization on a statistical basis

evidence.quote: Our analysis reveals a strong correspondence between the directions indicated by these two tracers across most of the galactic image.
Our findings indicate that VGT results generally concur with dust polarization on a statistical basis.

claims.hypothesis: Jets and outflows cause the gradient and polarization directions to differ
claims.experiment: Mapped AM and inspected regions with negative AM against the radio jet
claims.result: Anti-alignment (negative AM) in the two tails and in the radio jet regions
claims.finding: Anti-alignment in jet regions is consistent with gradients rotating in outflows, but its origin needs further study

evidence.quote: In particular, anti-alignment is present in the radio jet regions, which is expected for the outflow regions. Further studies of the origin of this discrepancy are required.

claims.hypothesis: Misalignment is related to data quality
claims.experiment: Examined the AM histogram as a function of signal-to-noise ratio
claims.result: Largest misalignment lies in low-density, low-SNR regions; no negative AM at high SNR
claims.finding: Alignment is most reliable where the SNR is highest

evidence.quote: We also note that the most significant misalignment between VGT-CO and dust polarization measurements is in the low-density regions associated with poor signal-to-noise ratio.

claims.hypothesis: Differences between warm dust and cold CO gas contribute to low-AM regions
claims.experiment: Compared low-AM regions with HI absorption and the different phases traced by 89 micron dust and CO
claims.result: Central low-AM region coincides with strong HI absorption
claims.finding: Low AM could reflect different field morphology in warm and cold gas (not tested directly)

evidence.quote: the morphology of magnetic fields with low-AM could reflect that the magnetic fields in warm and cold gas are different.

why_this_data.value: Centaurus is among the closest nuclear active galaxy mergers, so it is taken as a test-bed for VGT

evidence.quote: Centaurus galaxy, as one of the closest nuclear active galaxy mergers, is the best test-bed for VGT.

why_this_method.value: VGT with CO spectroscopy isolates the magnetic field associated with molecular gas, unlike dust polarization that mixes gas phases

evidence.quote: To separate the magnetic field associated with molecular gas, which is the most important fueling material for the galactic nuclei, (cite: 2022ApJ...941...92H) proposed the use of the Velocity Gradient Technique

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Other sub-block sizes than 20x20 pixels have been tested (in earlier work)

evidence.quote: although other sizes have been tested (cite: YL17a; LY18a; 2020ApJ...905..129H)

limitations_admitted.value: Merger dynamics are more complicated than in normal galaxies, making the comparison harder to interpret

evidence.quote: However, it should be noted that the dynamics of galaxy mergers are more complicated than normal galaxies. This makes the interpretation of the comparison more difficult.

limitations_admitted.value: Origin of the misalignment needs further study; higher-SNR data and synchrotron polarization are needed

evidence.quote: Future research, utilizing higher signal-to-noise data and incorporating synchrotron polarization, is essential to further explore these findings.
Further studies of the origin of this discrepancy are required.

referee_caveats_inferred: Line identification is inconsistent (CO J=2-1 vs J=1-0) for the same dataset
The paper gives no mean AM, uncertainties or quantitative SNR dependence; claims are mostly visual
VGT map resolution (~40'') is much coarser than the 8.13'' CO data, and the 145.5 pc scale is assumed adequate without test
The 3 x RMS threshold wording ('less than') looks like a typo
Single galaxy and single comparison tracer; HI contamination of dust polarization is argued, not tested
Jet-region anti-alignment is attributed to outflows without independent kinematic check
